theorem_title: Transport of a stored source-band record
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandData.At.transfer {μ ν : ℕ → ℤ} {f : ℕ → ℤ} {base n g p m i : ℕ} {shift : ℤ}
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandData.At μ f base n g p m shift i) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hhead : ∀ q < 6, ν (base+6*i+q)=μ (base+6*i+q))
    (hdata : ∀ x, _root_.ThreeSum.SourceBandLayout.hist base n g m i ≤ x → x < _root_.ThreeSum.SourceBandLayout.flat base n g m i+_root_.ThreeSum.SourceBandLayout.cap n g → ν x=μ x) :
    _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.SourceBandData.At ν f base n g p m shift i := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let $\mu,
u:\mathbb N	o\mathbb Z$ be memories and let a source-band record for an integer source function be valid in $\mu$. Assume its residue count $m$ is positive, all six header cells agree in $
u$, and $
u=\mu$ throughout the interval from that band's histogram base to its flat-index base plus allocated capacity. Then the same source-band record is valid in $
u$.

Allows later writes outside retained band data to preserve its exact stored interpretation. This is a supporting lemma in the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
